scope: Build 156 supplied INERT counters only; re-enumerate exact release commit including other workers additions

entries.steps: Implemented-unverified. EnableSmokeFixtures=true in the lead-only test profile (OFF by default). Run fx_trade near two real finite-reserve transient camps.
